# Agon Mustafaj

> SEO expert and web developer in Prishtina, Kosovo. Through AgoDev he improves search visibility and builds websites for businesses. He studies Computer Science at the University of Prishtina and works as an SEO Expert at Novalab SEO Agency.

The site is available in English and Albanian (the language switch is on every page). For a project, use the contact page or email agonmustafaj01@gmail.com.

## Services and work

- [AgoDev](https://agonmustafaj.com/agodev/): SEO services and web development, the build process, and client projects already live
- [Services](https://agonmustafaj.com/services/): technical SEO, on-page SEO and business websites in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
- [Freelancer in Kosovo](https://agonmustafaj.com/freelancer-kosove/): websites and technical SEO for businesses across Kosovo
- [Projects](https://agonmustafaj.com/projects/): overview of the websites built, each with a case study
- [Malaj Design case study](https://agonmustafaj.com/projects/malaj-design/): designer portfolio built in Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS
- [Banesë për Ty case study](https://agonmustafaj.com/projects/banese-per-ty/): rental platform with listings, digital contracts and payment verification
- [Hoxha Handwerk case study](https://agonmustafaj.com/projects/hoxha-handwerk/): multilingual website for a craft and trade business
- [VisitAlbania case study](https://agonmustafaj.com/projects/visit-albania/): tourism website in five languages, built with Drin Kozhani
